title: Fair Auto
notes: Bug fix: in 0.20.0 a mistake still turned every mashed press into a PERFECT PARRY, so spamming made you immortal. Fixed: mashing really only blocks now.
A block softens a hit (-35%) instead of halving it. Lifesteal is capped at 12%.
Enemies have a bit less HP and hit a bit harder, so fights are shorter and you can actually lose one.

Tested for all play styles: full AUTO (AUTO ATTACK + AUTO FARM) loses about 1 in 10 fights, active players with skills rarely, nobody is immortal and nobody dies instantly. Late elites are a bit softer.
